_note: Allowlist for ingest/ (enforced in ingest/allowlist.py). A domain is usable only if robots.txt AND terms were checked and dated. automated_fetch: Browserbase may load its pages. link_ok: we may store a link to its videos and play them in its own player (manual CSV adds need this). Social media is refused in code whatever this file says. Details and dates: docs/SOURCES.md.

sources.robots: web.archive.org has no robots.txt (404). archive.org/robots.txt disallows only /control/ and /report/ for all agents.
sources.terms: Access is for scholarship and research; do not interfere with servers or resources; use must be noninfringing or fair use; cite the Archive. No clause against automated access.
sources.checked_by: md's Claude; a person should confirm
sources.attribution: Archived copy from the Internet Archive Wayback Machine, captured {archive_date}.

sources.robots: Disallows /results, /api/, /youtubei/, /timedtext_video and others for all agents.
sources.terms: Terms dated 2023-12-15 bar access by automated means (robots, scrapers) except search engines or with written permission. Videos may be shown through the embeddable YouTube player. So: manual CSV only, play through the official embed.
sources.checked_by: md's Claude; a person should confirm

sources.robots: robots.txt disallows everything for named AI agents (ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, GPTBot, CCBot and others); for other agents it disallows /ajax, /common/services/, /MyC-SPAN/ and similar.
sources.terms: NOT VERIFIED. The terms page returned HTTP 403 to both our fetcher and the in-app browser. A person must read the terms in their own browser, fill this in and set link_ok before any C-SPAN video is added. Never automated: robots.txt excludes AI agents.

_per_candidate: Live campaign sites and legislature or government video archives are added here per candidate, after a person checks robots.txt and terms for that exact domain and records them in docs/SOURCES.md.
